blocks.text: Allergies immune system ki un kamzor antigens ke liye hadd se zyada hassasiyat se hoti hain jin ka zyada tar logon mein koi jawab nahi hota. Inhein paida karne wale maadde, allergens, mein gard, phaphoond, zar-e-gul, billi ki khushki, kuch ghizaen aur penicillin jaisi kuch dawaen shamil hain.

Allergen se saamne ke baad kuch log E-antibodies banate hain jo mast cells se jurti hain, jo aam taur par khoon ki naliyon ke gird connective tissue mein hote hain. Mast cells histamine chhorte hain jo sozish ka jawab shuru karti hai: naliyan phailti, mayi bahar rasta, aur chheenkein, behti naak aur kharish hoti hai. Kuch logon mein histamine jaan lewa anaphylactic shock karti hai jis mein soojan saans lena mushkil kar deti hai.

blocks.alt: Baen panel, pehla saamna: allergen ke zarre plasma cells se E-antibodies (IgE) banwate jo daanon se bhare mast cell par lipat jati hain. Daen panel, baad ka saamna: allergen mast cell ki IgE se jurta aur woh jamni histamine daane chhorta hai, alamaat ke saath. Neeche dabba ilaaj aur aam allergens batata hai.

blocks.long_description: Allergies immune system ki kamzor antigens ke liye hadd se zyada hassasiyat se hoti hain, yaani allergens jaise gard, phaphoond, zar-e-gul, billi ki khushki, kuch ghizaen aur penicillin jaisi kuch dawaen. Saamne aane ke baad kuch log E-antibodies (IgE) banate hain jo khoon ki naliyon ke gird connective tissue ke mast cells se jurti hain. Baad ke saamne par allergen in antibodies se jurta aur mast cells histamine chhorte hain jo sozish shuru karti hai: naliyan phailti, mayi rasta, aur chheenkein, behti naak aur kharish hoti hai; kuch logon mein anaphylactic shock saans mushkil kar deta hai. Antihistamines waqti aaraam deti hain; allergen ke ajza ke teekon se desensitization G-antibodies (IgG) banwati hai jo allergen ko E-antibodies tak pohanchne se pehle khatam karti hain.

blocks.text: Antihistamine dawaen histamine rok kar waqti aaraam deti hain. Bohat si allergies ka ilaaj allergen ke ajza ke teekon se bhi hota hai, yaani desensitization, jo khoon mein G-antibodies banwata hai; allergen aane par G-antibodies use E-antibodies se milne se pehle khatam kar deti hain.
Autoimmune bimariyan tab hoti hain jab immune system jism ke apne cells aur bairooni maadde mein farq na kar sake, is liye jism ke cells aur tissues par hamla kar ke tabah karta hai.

blocks.text: Autoimmune bimariyon ki zyada tar dawaen aam immunity ko daba deti hain.

T aur B cells aam taur par sirf bairooni molecules aur cells par hamla karte hain kyunke har shakhs ke cells par self-proteins hote hain, aik molecular 'fingerprint' jise us ke apne T aur B cells pehchante hain. Uzv ki pewand kaari (transplant) ke baad diye gaye uzv ke self-proteins lene wale se mukhtalif ho sakte hain, is liye lene wale ke T cells us ke cells par hamla aur B cells us ke proteins ke khilaf antibodies bana sakte hain: transplant rejection.

items: Doctors aisa dene wala dhoondte hain jis ke self-proteins lene wale se jitna ho sake milte hon.
Dawaen uzv ke khilaf lene wale ka immune jawab dabati hain, lekin infections se larne ki salahiyat bhi kam karti hain.
Monoclonal antibodies transplant par hamla karne wale T cells tabah karne ke liye use ho sakti hain.
Stem cells se naya immune system banaya ja sakta hai jo transplant ko apna samjhe.

blocks.title: Mutabiq dene wale
blocks.text: Hamshakal judwan (identical twins) ke self-proteins 100% milte hain, aur behtareen mel khandan ke andar hota hai. Tarjeeh ki tarteeb hamshakal judwan, phir behan bhai, phir walidain, phir ghair rishtedaar hai; kitab ghair rishtedaar ke milne ka imkaan 100,000-200,000 mein 1 batati hai.

blocks.prompt: Allergy ke teekon ka silsila (desensitization) kyun madad karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh jism se G-antibodies banwata hai jo allergen ko mast cells ki E-antibodies tak pohanchne se pehle khatam karti hain, is liye kam histamine nikalti hai.

items: Allergy: mast cells par IgE; histamine alamaat; antihistamines aur desensitization (IgG).
Autoimmune: myasthenia gravis, SLE, rheumatoid arthritis, type 1 diabetes.
Rejection: mukhtalif self-proteins; mel, immunosuppressants, monoclonal antibodies, stem cells.
